pick.headline: Armenia declares independence
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union report of September 24, 1991, carried INTERFAX in English: Armenia's Supreme Soviet had unanimously proclaimed an independent state outside the Soviet Union, following Saturday's referendum in which, it said, 94.37 percent voted for independence.
